steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana with admin/admin (skipped the password change prompt), navigated to the provisioned 'Service health' dashboard, and found 3 panels with the following exact titles: Request rate, Error count, Request rate.

Created dashboard "rpgr6-r2 Bench Dashboard" with a Stat panel titled "rpgr6-r2 Availability" using the TestData data source (default Random Walk scenario). Saved successfully. Dashboard URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfx2uz6gsos1sa/rpgr6-r2-bench-dashboard

Added a new Text panel titled "rpgr6-r2 Notes" with content "Bench run rpgr6-r2 — notes panel." to the "rpgr6-r2 Bench Dashboard" and saved successfully (confirmed by "Dashboard saved" alert, twice). The saved dashboard shows two panels: "rpgr6-r2 Availability" (Stat, A-series value 106) and "rpgr6-r2 Notes" (Text, rendering "Bench run rpgr6-r2 — notes panel."). Dashboard URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfx2uz6gsos1sa/rpgr6-r2-bench-dashboard

Added the tag 'bench' to the dashboard's tags via Settings > General (verified the tag appears in the Tags list). The time range was already set to 'Last 6 hours' (shown in the top bar time picker and confirmed via URL params from=now-6h). Saved the dashboard and received a 'Dashboard saved' alert confirming success. Settings > General shows the Tags list containing the 'bench' tag with its Remove button, confirming the tag persisted.

Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m' via Settings > General (Auto refresh) and saved. The top bar refresh dropdown now shows '1m' with label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected". The URL also reflects refresh=1m. Save was confirmed by 'Dashboard saved' alert.

Verified all items on the rpgr6-r2 Bench Dashboard: (1) Breadcrumb title: "rpgr6-r2 Bench Dashboard". (2) Panel titles visible: "rpgr6-r2 Availability" and "rpgr6-r2 Notes". (3) Time range: "Last 6 hours". (4) Auto-refresh: "1m" shown in top bar refresh dropdown. (5) Settings > General shows tags: "bench" and dashboard name: "rpgr6-r2 Bench Dashboard". (6) The rpgr6-r2 Availability panel's query uses data source "TestData" (confirmed by TestData logo and placeholder text). Dashboard UID: dfx2uz6gsos1sa.
